question: After changing the Metal plugin CodeDirectory from SHA-1 to SHA-256 (and its three cdhashes in the owner trust module), does AMFI's mac_vnode_check_signature fatal disappear, and does Metal get loaded?
verdict_part1: PASS. Three independent boots of this package all show mac_vnode_check_signature = 0 and 'Hash type is not SHA256' = 0, while l690/l695 (SHA-1 addon) show 4 fatals each at t≈128 s. The identical kernel with only the addon CD hash type changed is what removes the fatal, so the root cause 'AMFI requires SHA-256 CD' is confirmed on hardware.
frames: xfer=6 (run1), xfer=5 (run2) — same order as l690's 5/6, i.e. does NOT grow
verdict_part2: OPEN. No display-link / Metal-driven frame growth yet. Note the CDC only proves 'no fatal'; it cannot prove the plugin was actually attempted and loaded. Next evidence must come from the userland side (launchd.log / tracev3: MetalPluginName resolution, NativeAdrenoMetalDevice instantiation, BKDisplayLink).
board_state: LOOPING. Because this round flashed boot_a inside the fastboot session, ABL lost the misc boot-recovery marker; every kernel reset now boots boot_a straight back into the same kernel (≈255–300 s per cycle). USB control channel 'reboot' resets into the same loop. Needs a fastboot/recovery entry to break.
lesson: Never flash boot_a in the same fastboot session that then boots the round; if a flash is unavoidable, re-arm misc with `fastboot flash misc misc-bootrecovery.bin` afterwards (see tmp/go_round_next.sh).
